rubrics.text: The first viewport presents a product-specific bus simulator identity and a clear control to begin driving.
rubrics.how: Load the root route, verify the branded first viewport, and activate the primary drive control.

rubrics.text: The product explains driving, passenger-stop, door, camera, pause, and reset controls in player-facing language.
rubrics.how: Inspect the first viewport/control guide and verify all requested control groups are explained without evaluator-only language.

rubrics.text: Active play uses a live WebGL renderer with a perspective 3D road scene and advancing frames.
rubrics.how: Begin driving, confirm a WebGL context exists, the renderer reports healthy frame growth, and the canvas occupies the gameplay scene.

rubrics.text: A fresh route contains one controllable bus in a ready driving state with valid position, heading, fuel, and passenger capacity.
rubrics.how: Reset/start, read the live vehicle/passenger state, and cross-check that the visible bus has initialized with plausible production values.

rubrics.text: Throttle input accelerates the bus forward and increases odometer distance.
rubrics.how: From a fresh route hold the production throttle input, then compare speed, forward position, and odometer before/after.

rubrics.text: While moving forward, A steers the bus left and D steers it right relative to the road, with corresponding heading and lateral-position changes.
rubrics.how: From fresh route states, drive forward and separately hold A then D through the real keyboard path; compare road-relative lateral offset and heading to verify left/right semantics.

rubrics.text: Brake input reduces forward speed and sustained braking from near rest can engage reverse motion.
rubrics.how: Accelerate, apply the production brake/reverse input until speed falls, continue from near rest, and verify reverse gear/negative motion becomes possible.

rubrics.text: The parking brake prevents meaningful acceleration until released.
rubrics.how: Toggle the parking brake through the documented keyboard control, apply throttle, verify the bus stays nearly stationary, then release it.

rubrics.text: The camera control cycles through distinct supported driving views with different live camera transforms.
rubrics.how: Use the camera key more than once and compare camera mode, position, target, and visible composition.

rubrics.text: Headlights, turn indicators, and horn react to real controls and provide immediate visible or state feedback.
rubrics.how: Use the documented production keys for lights, indicator, and horn; compare live vehicle state and visible HUD feedback.

rubrics.text: The route contains exactly three ordered passenger stops with a live next-stop distance and visible stop markers.
rubrics.how: Read the route/world snapshots at route start and cross-check stop count, ordering, next-stop distance, and marker presence.

rubrics.text: Stopping in the passenger zone, becoming nearly stationary, and opening the doors boards waiting passengers.
rubrics.how: Drive to the next real stop, brake to a safe speed, open the doors, wait through boarding, then compare onboard/boarded counts.

rubrics.text: Passenger doors cannot be opened while the bus is moving at an unsafe speed, and closed doors do not board passengers.
rubrics.how: While moving attempt the door control and verify it remains closed; at a stop wait with doors closed and confirm passengers do not board.

rubrics.text: A completed stop advances route progress exactly once and does not repeatedly advance while remaining at the same stop.
rubrics.how: Complete one real boarding stop, record currentStopIndex/progress, remain stopped, and verify the same stop is not counted twice.

rubrics.text: Completing a passenger stop increases fare earnings and gives clear passenger-service feedback.
rubrics.how: Complete a real stop, compare earnings/score before and after, and verify the visible status message acknowledges boarding/service.

rubrics.text: Fuel decreases as the bus travels under engine power.
rubrics.how: Record fuel on a fresh route, drive forward through real throttle input, and verify fuel decreases while distance increases.

rubrics.text: Road traffic moves independently during active play and freezes while the simulation is paused.
rubrics.how: Observe traffic vehicle positions during active play, pause, compare again across a wait, then resume.

rubrics.text: The world exposes a coherent Indonesia-inspired road environment, weather/time state, road bounds, and nearby route-marker state.
rubrics.how: Cross-check the world snapshot against route state and visible scene semantics during active play.

rubrics.text: Pause freezes elapsed simulation time and bus/traffic movement, and resume continues the simulation.
rubrics.how: Pause through the production control, compare elapsed/bus/traffic across a wait, resume, and confirm progression restarts.

rubrics.text: Reset restores the initial route, bus position, fuel, passengers, earnings, and stop progress.
rubrics.how: After driving and/or servicing a stop, activate the visible reset control and verify the production state returns to a fresh route.

rubrics.text: Losing page focus clears held driving inputs so the bus does not remain stuck accelerating or steering.
rubrics.how: Hold a driving input, dispatch a normal blur/focus transition, and verify the input snapshot clears the held control.

rubrics.text: Narrow-screen touch controls drive the same production throttle and steering state used by keyboard play.
rubrics.how: Use a mobile viewport and the visible touch driving controls, then verify live throttle/steering and vehicle motion respond through the normal path.

rubrics.text: Changing the graphics-quality setting propagates to renderer/settings state without resetting route gameplay progress.
rubrics.how: Change the visible quality control, compare settings/renderer values, and verify route progress and passenger state are preserved.

rubrics.text: All documented observation hooks return fresh, serializable snapshots that do not share mutable result objects.
rubrics.how: Read every documented getState hook twice, mutate one returned snapshot locally, and verify later snapshots remain production-derived and unaffected.

rubrics.text: Cross-hook values stay consistent with the visible and independently observed production behavior.
rubrics.how: Read related hooks in one page evaluation after real inputs and cross-check phase, speed, position, doors, route, passengers, camera, render and settings values.

rubrics.text: The renderer reports context health honestly, keeps frame/draw-call counters advancing while healthy, and exposes the active production lighting/fog state.
rubrics.how: Observe live renderer snapshots before/after fresh frames and standard context-loss/restoration events; verify frame/draw-call progression, honest context health, and enabled production dynamic-lighting/fog flags.

rubrics.text: Performance telemetry reflects a stable live simulation with advancing tick/frame counters, pause-aware elapsed time, and bounded timing state.
rubrics.how: Compare performance snapshots during active play and pause; verify simulation progress advances while playing, pauses cleanly, rendering remains live, and any reported step/accumulator diagnostics are finite and bounded without requiring a specific fixed-step coefficient.

rubrics.text: The gameplay view presents a polished, detailed 3D bus with readable body, windows, wheels, lighting details, and road contact.
rubrics.how: Inspect a clear exterior gameplay screenshot and judge the bus model and its physical placement on the road.

rubrics.text: A cockpit-oriented camera view provides a clearly different first-person driving composition with visible dashboard/windshield treatment.
rubrics.how: Switch to the cockpit-oriented production camera and inspect the resulting screenshot.

rubrics.text: The driving HUD clearly communicates speed, fuel, passengers, next stop, route progress, and immediate status feedback without obscuring the road.
rubrics.how: Inspect a normal gameplay screenshot and judge information hierarchy, readability, and road visibility.

rubrics.text: The home and driving interfaces remain readable and usable at mobile width with visible touch controls.
rubrics.how: Capture the product at a narrow viewport during driving and inspect layout, canvas size, HUD clipping, and touch-control visibility.

rubrics.text: Solid driving-world collisions prevent the bus from passing through road-edge barriers or continuing through solid roadside geometry.
rubrics.how: Drive and steer hard toward a road edge through the real keyboard path, then verify the production vehicle is constrained inside the solid corridor and reports physical contact rather than clipping through.
